description: M15 full material registry — 50+ launch materials with Noita-grade chemistry. Per-material thermal + electrical + chemical properties + phase transitions + reaction hooks. All 9 DR-007 affordance flags populated + M15 simulation properties (state, melting_point, boiling_point, ignition_point, conductivity_thermal, conductivity_electrical, viscosity, flammability, reactivity_acid, reactivity_water, reactivity_oxygen, friction, restitution, stickiness). Phase-transition pairs (melts_to, freezes_to, vaporizes_to, condenses_to, burns_to) reference other material ids. Status: PROPOSED — feeds M15 (Active Material Kernel; BP4). Schema follows material_registry.json v1 with v2 extensions.

materials.name: air
materials.description: Standard atmospheric air mix. ~21% O2 + 78% N2 + trace gases. Default empty space.

materials.name: dirt
materials.description: Soft topsoil. Digger carves easily. When wet, becomes mud. When fired (3+ hits), hardens to baked_clay.

materials.name: concrete
materials.description: Reinforced bunker wall. Rifle ineffective. Drill carves slowly. Heat-resistant up to 1700 K.

materials.name: metal_nohook
materials.description: Hardened RHA-grade steel. Cannot dig. Plasma cutter or shaped charge required to breach. Conducts heat + electricity rapidly.

materials.name: hazard
materials.description: Generic damage-on-touch surface. Material-agnostic placeholder; M16 hazard package owns the specific variants (fire, acid, electric, etc.).

materials.name: loose_fill
materials.description: Crushed concrete + dirt mix. Movement slowdown 30%. Low structural support — collapses on weight.

materials.name: repair_fill
materials.description: Player-placed structural foam. Creates cover instantly + restores pathability. Cures in 8 seconds; weaker before cure.

materials.name: anchor
materials.description: Hard anchorable bedrock. Tether attaches reliably. Drill carves slowly; shaped charge breaches.

materials.name: sand
materials.description: Loose silica grain. Flows under gravity. Slough-falls when undermined. Fuses to glass at 1873 K.

materials.name: wood
materials.description: Dry timber. Bullets pass at 30% energy loss. Ignites at 575 K; burns vigorously to ash + smoke.

materials.name: glass
materials.description: Transparent silicate. Shatters on impact — projectiles pass with 10% energy loss + spawn shards (sharp_debris hazard). Heat-fuses cracks.

materials.name: ice
materials.description: Frozen water. Slippery friction 0.05. Melts at 273.15 K to water. Native to Europa subsurface + Mimas glaciers.

materials.name: basalt
materials.description: Volcanic bedrock. Cannot anchor (nohook). Bullets ricochet. Drill carves very slowly. Native to Vulcan + Mars.

materials.name: water
materials.description: Liquid H2O. Conducts electricity when contaminated. Freezes at 273.15 K to ice; boils at 373.15 K to steam.

materials.name: steam
materials.description: Water vapor (gaseous H2O). 373.15 K+ = thermal hazard. Condenses on cold surfaces back to water. Obscures vision but allows projectiles.

materials.name: lava
materials.description: Molten silicate magma. 1473 K+ contact damage 80 HP/s. Cools to basalt over 60 seconds. Native to Vulcan magma chambers.

materials.name: oil
materials.description: Petroleum slick. Slippery friction 0.05. Ignites at 525 K to fire + smoke. Robots leak this; oil reservoir empty = joints seize.

materials.name: fire
materials.description: Combustion plasma. 1100 K. Spreads to adjacent flammable at 1-tile/s. Consumes oxygen. Burns 30s in atmospheric O2; longer with fuel.

materials.name: smoke
materials.description: Combustion byproduct. Obscures vision; pressure-driven diffusion 2-tile/s. Causes coughing affliction at 5s+ exposure (M16).

materials.name: ash
materials.description: Combustion residue. Settles after fire burns out. Insulating; reduces conduction. Slough-falls under undermining.

materials.name: acid
materials.description: Corrosive liquid (~pH 1; sulfuric / hydrochloric mix). Eats metal/concrete/flesh at 5 HP/s contact. Neutralized by base material.

materials.name: acid_fumes
materials.description: Acid vapor. Caustic — applies acid_burn affliction at 2 HP/s exposure. Pressure-driven diffusion; neutralized by base aerosol.

materials.name: rust
materials.description: Iron oxide from acid+iron reaction. Brittle (low hardness). Flakes off under impact. Cannot re-form into metal without forging.

materials.name: blood
materials.description: Human / android / heavy biomech survival resource (red variant). Pools on tile contact. Coagulates over 30s. Slippery 0.15.

materials.name: synth_blood
materials.description: Android survival resource. Slower coagulation than blood (60s). Pinkish-magenta. Conducts electricity better than blood.

materials.name: synth_oil
materials.description: Robot joint lubricant. Drains when robot is wounded. Empty = joints seize. Flammable (ignites at 590 K). Dark green / black.

materials.name: bio_fluid
materials.description: Heavy biomech survival fluid. Slow coagulation (90s+). Higher density than blood; carries bio_energy. Bluish.

materials.name: molten_steel
materials.description: Molten iron at 1810 K+. 100 HP/s contact damage. Cools to metal_reforged (forge-grade) over 30s. Conducts electricity strongly.

materials.name: molten_glass
materials.description: Molten silicate at 1473 K+. 80 HP/s contact damage. Cools to glass over 20s. Lava + sand creates this.

materials.name: magma_basaltic
materials.description: Deep-mantle melt. 1573 K+. 100 HP/s contact. Slower flow than lava. Cools to basalt over 90s.

materials.name: magma_granitic
materials.description: Lighter crustal melt. 1473 K. Cools to anchor (granite) over 70s. Higher silica = more viscous.

materials.name: metal_reforged
materials.description: Solidified molten steel. Forge-grade material. Anchorable (unlike metal_nohook). Crafting reagent for armor + weapons.

materials.name: obsidian
materials.description: Volcanic glass from lava + water rapid cooling. Razor-sharp shards on impact (sharp_debris hazard). Native to Vulcan.

materials.name: snow
materials.description: Loose frozen flakes. Insulating. Melts to water at 273 K. Native to Mimas + Europa polar regions.

materials.name: mud
materials.description: Dirt + water mix. Slows movement 40%. Splash debris. Dries to dirt over 60s in heat.

materials.name: baked_clay
materials.description: Fired earthenware. Reasonable cover. Crumbles to dirt under heavy impact. Native to dry kiln zones.

materials.name: salt
materials.description: NaCl. Dissolves in water to brine. Settles. Crafting reagent for chemistry.

materials.name: molten_salt
materials.description: Molten NaCl at 1074 K. 70 HP/s contact damage. Solidifies to salt over 20s. Used in advanced reactors (M29).

materials.name: brine
materials.description: Saltwater. Lower freezing point than water (252 K). Conducts electricity strongly. Corrodes iron faster than water.

materials.name: brine_ice
materials.description: Frozen brine. Tinted bluish-gray. Melts to brine at 252 K. Common in Europa subsurface.

materials.name: gunpowder
materials.description: Black powder (KNO3 + S + C). Ignites at 425 K. Explosive cascade — fire spreads through gunpowder field at 5-tile/s.

materials.name: thermite
materials.description: Fe2O3 + Al powder. Ignites at 1473 K (requires high heat). Burns at 3000 K — melts steel. Used for breaching vaults.

materials.name: plasma
materials.description: Ionized gas at 10000+ K. Plasma cutter projectile material. 200 HP/s contact. Cools to air over 2 seconds. Conducts electricity wildly.

materials.name: methane
materials.description: CH4 (a.k.a. Volatiles per Stationeers parity). Methane-breather race's breathable atmosphere. Flammable: ignites at 810 K. Auto-ignition triggers thermal cascade.

materials.name: liquid_methane
materials.description: Liquid CH4 at 111 K. Cryogenic burn affliction. Vaporizes rapidly when heated. Used as rocket fuel + powerplant feedstock. Native to Mimas seas.

materials.name: hydrogen
materials.description: H2. Lightest gas — rises rapidly. Ignites at 793 K. Explosive in 4-75% air mixture. Used as fuel + life support feedstock.

materials.name: liquid_hydrogen
materials.description: LH2 at 20 K. Extreme cryogenic burn. Used in rocket second stages. Vaporizes immediately on warming.

materials.name: oxygen
materials.description: O2. Standard atmosphere component. Required by humans / androids / heavy biomech. POISON to methane-breathers. Supports combustion.

materials.name: liquid_oxygen
materials.description: LOX at 90 K. Cryogenic burn affliction. Used in rocket first stages. Strongly supports combustion — vaporizes around fire = explosive cascade.

materials.name: nitrogen
materials.description: N2. 78% of standard atmosphere. Inert. Crystalline-race breathable. Liquid N2 (LN2) used for cryocooling.

materials.name: liquid_nitrogen
materials.description: LN2 at 77 K. Cryogenic burn affliction. Used to freeze things instantly. Vaporizes rapidly = pressure cascade in sealed rooms.

materials.name: co2
materials.description: CO2. Photosynthetic-race breathable; suffocates O2-breathers at high concentration. Heavier than air — pools in low areas.

materials.name: dry_ice
materials.description: Frozen CO2 at 195 K. Sublimates directly to CO2 gas. Cryogenic burn on contact. Foggy white.

materials.name: ozone
materials.description: O3. Highly reactive. Created by electrical arcs in air. Burns lung tissue (lung_damage affliction). Decomposes to O2 over 30s.

materials.name: helium
materials.description: He. Inert noble gas. Rises rapidly. Used for cryocooling + airships. Aqueous-race may breathe high-He mixtures.

materials.name: pollutant
materials.description: Industrial pollutant gas (Stationeers parity). Suffocates O2-breathers. Filterable. Often byproduct of combustion + machinery.

materials.name: nitrous_oxide
materials.description: N2O. Mild anesthetic affliction (drowsy). High-concentration supports combustion = rocket oxidizer (per Stationeers parity).

materials.name: alien_resin
materials.description: Insectoid biomaterial. Sticky (0.85). Adheres to actors — slow movement 60%. Burns to acid + smoke. Found in insectoid hives.

materials.name: crystal
materials.description: Silicate-based energy crystal (Crystalline race material). Refracts light. Stores electrical charge (capacitor-grade). Mining yield: rare-tier loot.

materials.name: plant_fiber
materials.description: Photosynthetic-race plant material. Generates O2 in sunlight. Burns easily. Crafting reagent for paper / rope / textile.

materials.name: polluted_oxygen
materials.description: O2 + impurities (ONI parity). Breathable but causes mild lung damage. Filterable to clean O2 + pollutant.

materials.name: polluted_water
materials.description: Water + impurities (ONI parity). Conducts electricity strongly. Causes disease affliction at 20s+ exposure. Filterable.

materials.name: carbon
materials.description: Pure carbon powder (charcoal / soot). Burns to CO2. Crafting reagent for steel-making + gunpowder.

materials.name: iron_ore
materials.description: Raw iron ore. Mining yield: smelts to iron / steel. Tier 1 ore. Common in Mars + Belt.

materials.name: copper_ore
materials.description: Raw copper ore. Smelts to copper (high conductivity). Tier 1 ore. Common in Earth + Mars.

materials.name: molten_copper
materials.description: Molten copper at 1358 K+. 90 HP/s contact. Cools to copper (high electrical conductivity).

materials.name: copper
materials.description: Refined copper. High electrical conductivity (cable / wire material). Heat-conductive. Softer than steel but pricier.

materials.name: insulite
materials.description: Synthetic thermal insulator (ONI parity). Thermal conductivity 0.01 (best in launch roster). Used to seal habitat walls against extreme temperatures.

materials.name: neutronium
materials.description: Hyper-dense alien material (ONI parity). Indestructible at launch. Bedrock for habitat foundations. Material Lab-unlocked.
